notes.buttons:
decorateButtons() requires an authored (primary) or (secondary) around a lone link in a

; = accent. Foundation maps source .button to every a.button and source .button.big to a.button.accent (or a block-set .big).
notes.sections: main is the source #wrapper column (64em, max-width calc(100% - 4em)); each main > .section is a source .main panel (margin-bottom 4em / 2em <=980 / 1em <=736). Panel chrome (white surface, padding, radius) belongs to blocks or section-metadata styles, not the foundation.
notes.chrome: header block renders nav#myTopnav.topnav from /nav (list of links); footer block renders the source #footer from /footer (social link list + copyright). True roots for chrome parity: nav=#myTopnav|#myTopnav, foot=#footer|body > footer.
notes.fonts: styles/fonts.css: Source Sans Pro 200/400 + FontAwesome 4.6.3, self-hosted in /fonts; --body-font-size custom property carries the body size per breakpoint
